enGB: Vengeful Counterstrike

Your fury answers every miss. When a melee attack misses you and the attacker is within your reach, you may make an attack of opportunity against them. This uses and is limited by your normal attacks of opportunity per round.
Prerequisites: Dex 13, Combat Reflexes.
Arcane Momentum

The surge of your most potent magic carries into your defenses. Whenever you cast a spell using one of your highest-level spell slots, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.
Prerequisites: Caster level 3rd.
Arcane Momentum
The cast of a powerful spell leaves a ward of force shimmering around this character, granting a +1 dodge bonus to AC.
Battlefield Scavenger

Precision comes cheap when the target stops moving. When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a ranged weapon attack, your next ranged attack within 1 round gains a +2 bonus on the attack roll.
Prerequisites: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot.
Battlefield Scavenger
Riding the momentum of a kill, this character's next ranged attack gains a +2 bonus on the attack roll.
Second Wind

Once per day, when a hit brings you to half your maximum hit points or below, you catch a second wind: you gain temporary hit points equal to your character level (minimum 2) and a +2 morale bonus on Fortitude saves for 1 minute. The daily use is restored when you rest.
Prerequisites: Endurance.
Second Wind
Gritting through the pain, this character gains temporary hit points equal to their character level and a +2 morale bonus on Fortitude saves.
Taunting Blows

Your brutal swings do more than wound. When you hit with a melee attack while Power Attack is active, the target suffers a -2 penalty on attack rolls for 1 round as pain and fury cloud its focus. A new hit refreshes the duration.
Prerequisites: Str 13, Power Attack.
Taunted
Staggered by a vicious blow, this creature takes a -2 penalty on attack rolls.
Resonant Strikes

Your unarmed strikes carry a harmonic shock. When you confirm a critical hit with an unarmed strike, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your character level + your Wisdom modifier) or have its guard rattled: it takes a -2 penalty to AC for 1 round. The penalty cannot be applied again while it is already active.
Prerequisites: Wis 13, Improved Unarmed Strike.
Rattled Guard
Harmonic vibrations from an unarmed critical strike rattle this creature's defenses, imposing a -2 penalty to AC.
Warded Soul

You were born under the wardstones of Kenabres, and their echo lingers in your blood. You gain a +1 luck bonus on Fortitude, Reflex, and Will saving throws.
Prerequisites: Iron Will.
Mission Vanguard

A test harness for the Mission WOTR mod: this archetype grants all seven Mission WOTR feats at level 1, along with the vanilla feats they normally require, so their mechanics can be exercised from the first fight. It removes nothing from the standard Magus kit. Intended to be expanded into a full class in a future version.
Acrobatic (Mythic)

You move with impossible grace, twisting through the air like a leaf on the wind. You gain an additional +4 bonus on Mobility and Athletics checks.
Adapted from the tabletop mythic feat; Wrath folds Acrobatics and Fly into Mobility and Athletics.
Persuasive (Mythic)

Your words bend wills like reeds in a storm, and no lie slips past you. You gain an additional +4 bonus on Persuasion checks and an additional +4 bonus on Perception checks.
Prerequisites: Persuasive.
Adapted from the tabletop mythic feat; Wrath folds Sense Motive into Persuasion and Perception.
Magical Aptitude (Mythic)

Magic answers your touch like an old friend. You gain an additional +4 bonus on Knowledge (Arcana) and Use Magic Device checks.
Adapted from the tabletop mythic feat.
Slayer's Vigor

Death feeds your legend. Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, you gain temporary hit points equal to your mythic rank (minimum 2) for 1 minute. This cannot be gained again while active.
Slayer's Vigor
Legends are written in blood. The character's latest kill invigorates them, granting temporary hit points.
Ascendant Edge

Your spells leave a wake of power that sharpens your strikes. Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher from one of your spellbooks, you gain a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls for 1 round, increasing by +1 for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +1). This cannot be gained again while active.
Ascendant Edge
The residue of a recent spell hones this character's aim, granting an insight bonus on attack rolls.
Iron Will (Mythic)

Your mind is a fortress no mortal power may breach. You gain a +1 insight bonus on Will saving throws for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +2).
Prerequisites: Iron Will.
Lightning Reflexes (Mythic)

You react to danger before it finishes arriving. You gain a +1 insight bonus on Reflex saving throws for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +2).
Prerequisites: Lightning Reflexes.
Endurance (Mythic)

Your body endures what should destroy it. You gain a +1 insight bonus on Fortitude saving throws for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +2).
Prerequisites: Endurance.
Untouchable
Blades pass through the spaces you occupied a heartbeat ago. You gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +1).
Last Stand
Wounds focus the legend within. While you are at or below half your hit points, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +1).
Desperate Fury
Nothing sharpens the mind like mortality. While you are at or below half your hit points, you gain a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +1).
Defiant Soul

Every assault you shrug off stokes the legend. Whenever you succeed at a saving throw against an effect created by another creature, you gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls for 1 round per 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +2). This cannot be gained again while active.
Defiant Soul
Having just shrugged off an enemy effect, this character fights with renewed conviction, gaining a morale bonus on attack rolls.
Relentless Onslaught

A kill today is momentum for the next. Whenever you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, you gain a +1 insight bonus on attack rolls for 1 round per 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +2). This cannot be gained again while active.
Relentless Onslaught
Fresh from a kill, this character's next blows strike with terrifying precision, gaining an insight bonus on attack rolls.
Aetherial Bulwark

Magic leaves a shield in its wake. Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher from one of your spellbooks, you gain a +1 deflection bonus to AC for 1 round per 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +1). This cannot be gained again while active.
Aetherial Bulwark
The residue of a recently cast spell forms a protective shell around this character, granting a deflection bonus to AC.
Titan's Wrath
The strength of legend flows through every blow. You gain a +1 mythic bonus on weapon damage rolls for every mythic rank you possess.
Titan Hide
Your flesh hardens like living stone. You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to AC for every 2 mythic ranks you possess (minimum +1).
Steadfast Aim

Pick your moment when steel is already crossed. You gain a +1 bonus on ranged attack rolls against enemies engaged in melee with one of your allies.
Prerequisites: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot.
Guarded Momentum

Each blow that fails to find you hardens your guard. Each time a melee attack misses you, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, stacking up to +3.
Prerequisites: Combat Expertise.
Guarded Momentum
Turning aside successive blows, this character's guard grows harder to breach, granting a dodge bonus to AC.
Tunnel Fighter

You hold ground like a cornered beast. While this stance is active, you may make any number of attacks of opportunity each round, but you take a -2 penalty on all attack rolls.
Prerequisites: Combat Reflexes.
Tunnel Fighter
Fighting with the desperate precision of a cornered beast, this character makes any number of attacks of opportunity but suffers a penalty on attack rolls.
Eldritch Poisoner

An eldritch poisoner blends volatile chemicals and her own personal magic to create deadly poisons known as arcanotoxins.
Arcanotoxin: A number of times per day equal to her alchemist level + her Intelligence modifier, she can brew a dose of arcanotoxin and coat a weapon with it. Weapon hits then deliver the toxin: Fortitude save (DC 10 + half alchemist level + Intelligence) or 1d2 Strength damage. Arcanotoxin is supernatural and bypasses poison immunity, though creatures immune to poison resist it (+4 on the save).
This archetype replaces bomb, Throw Anything, and mutagen; it grants sneak attack as a rogue.
Ported from Pathfinder Player Companion: Black Markets.
Arcanotoxin

You blend volatile chemicals and your own personal magic to create deadly poisons known as arcanotoxins. A number of times per day equal to your alchemist level + your Intelligence modifier, you can brew a dose of arcanotoxin and coat your weapon with it for 1 minute. While coated, your weapon hits deliver the toxin: the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half your alchemist level + your Intelligence modifier) or take 1d2 Strength damage as the toxin courses through its veins for 2 rounds. A creature cannot be affected by a new dose while the toxin is already in its system.
Arcanotoxin is supernatural: it functions even against creatures immune to poison, though such creatures resist it and receive a +4 bonus on the saving throw.
Brew Arcanotoxin
Brew a dose of arcanotoxin (expending one daily use) and coat your weapon with it for 1 minute. Standard action.
Brew Arcanotoxin (Expedited)

Brew and apply a dose of arcanotoxin as a swift action - at a price. You lose 25% of your maximum hit points, or only 15% if you succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save. This can never reduce you below 1 hit point.
Arcanotoxin Coating
A sheen of supernatural poison coats this character's weapon. Hits with the weapon deliver the arcanotoxin.
Arcanotoxin
A supernatural poison courses through this character's veins, weakening its muscles.
Toxicologist
You are trained in the creation of poisons and antitoxins. You gain a +2 bonus on Lore (Nature) checks related to alchemy and toxins.
Expedited Synthesis

Your body has become a catalyst. You may brew and apply a dose of arcanotoxin as a swift action instead of a standard action - but the accelerated reaction burns you: you lose 25% of your maximum hit points, or only 15% if you succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save. This can never reduce you below 1 hit point.
Sickening Toxin

Your arcanotoxin leaves victims retching. When a creature fails its saving throw against your arcanotoxin, it is also sickened for the toxin's duration. Beginning at 12th level, targets are nauseated instead.
Mind-Altering Toxin

Your arcanotoxin induces vivid hallucinations. When a creature fails its saving throw against your arcanotoxin, it is also dazzled for the toxin's duration. Beginning at 10th level, targets are confused instead.
Prerequisites: Eldritch Poisoner, alchemist level 6.
Paralytic Toxin

Your arcanotoxin locks muscles rigid. When a creature fails its saving throw against your arcanotoxin, it is also staggered for the toxin's duration. Beginning at 15th level, targets are paralyzed instead.
Prerequisites: Eldritch Poisoner, alchemist level 8.
Lethal Toxin

Your arcanotoxin attacks life itself. Your arcanotoxin deals Constitution damage instead of Strength damage.
Prerequisites: Eldritch Poisoner, alchemist level 10.
Combine Toxins
You diversify your arcanotoxin, striking both muscle and reflex. Your arcanotoxin deals 1 point of Strength damage and 1 point of Dexterity damage instead of its normal damage.
Contact Toxin

You can create your arcanotoxin as a contact poison, delivered by a hurled vial. You may throw a vial of arcanotoxin at an enemy within 30 feet as a standard action; on contact it delivers your arcanotoxin at a save DC 2 lower than normal.
Prerequisites: Eldritch Poisoner, alchemist level 4.
Throw Contact Toxin
Hurl a vial of contact arcanotoxin at an enemy (expending one daily use). On contact, it delivers your arcanotoxin with a save DC 2 lower than normal.
Toxic Fumes

You can create your arcanotoxin as an inhaled poison. You may throw a vial of arcanotoxin that bursts in a 10-foot cloud (expending one daily use); enemies in the area are subjected to your arcanotoxin with a save DC 4 lower than normal.
Prerequisites: Eldritch Poisoner, alchemist level 6.
Throw Toxic Fumes
Hurl a vial of arcanotoxin that bursts into a 10-foot cloud of fumes (expending one daily use). Enemies in the area are subjected to your arcanotoxin with a save DC 4 lower than normal.
Envenom
You can create and apply your arcanotoxin to a held weapon - your own or an ally's - as a move action. The toxin lasts 1 minute or until used.
Envenom Ally's Weapon
Brew a dose of arcanotoxin (expending one daily use) and coat the target's weapon with it for 1 minute. Move action.
Antidote
You can sacrifice one use of your arcanotoxin to create an extract of delay poison, which you can feed to an adjacent willing creature as a standard action.
Antidote
Sacrifice one use of arcanotoxin to shield an ally from poison for 1 minute, as delay poison.
Apothecary
You know venoms the way a scholar knows books. You gain a bonus on Lore (Nature) checks equal to half your alchemist level.
Careful Injection
You know precisely where a blade carries poison best. When you deliver your arcanotoxin with a sneak attack, the saving throw DC increases by 2.
Construct Crafter

A metallics-themed engineer who deploys construct summons: uncontrollable, relentless, and deliberately less customizable than any companion. You may have one construct of each base active at a time; deploying the same base again replaces the old construct.
Deployable bases: Iron-Hearted Hound (level 1), Humanoid Construct (level 7), Stone Golem (level 16). Cores (stat packages) and programs (behavior packages) are chosen before deployment.
The archetype keeps the alchemist's hit dice and attack progression but trades away mutagen and the alchemist's poison-related features, and grants an extra combat feat at level 1.
Deploy Iron-Hearted Hound

Deploy an iron-hearted hound - a dog whose iron heart makes it immune to fear and mind control (standard action). Its plating grants damage reduction equal to half your alchemist level, bypassed by adamantine. The hound acts on its own - it cannot be controlled - and remains until destroyed or until you deploy another hound.
Deploy Humanoid Construct

Deploy a humanoid construct (standard action): a fighter with fighter levels equal to your alchemist level minus 2, equipped with simple arms and armor. It acts on its own and remains until destroyed or replaced.
Deploy Stone Golem

Deploy a stone golem (standard action): a hulking construct without its kind's berserk tendency and somewhat weaker than the standard golem. It acts on its own and remains until destroyed or replaced.
Basic Core
The basic core: each base deploys with its standard chassis - the hound's plating, the humanoid's fighter training, and the golem's bulk. Future cores will offer different stat packages.
Basic Program
The basic program: the construct charges the nearest enemy and attacks until it or the enemy is destroyed. Future programs will offer other behaviors.
Construct Core
Choose the core that powers your constructs. The core determines their stat package.
Construct Program
Choose the program that directs your constructs. The program determines their behavior.
Clockwork Plating
Masterwork plating grants this construct damage reduction equal to half its crafter's alchemist level, bypassed by adamantine weapons.
Crafter's Proficiencies
You are trained with light armor, longbows, shortbows, throwing axes, flails, heavy flails, warhammers, greatclubs, and simple weapons.
Dampened Synthesis
Your extract formulae are deliberately hasty imitations. Your caster level for alchemist extracts is reduced (one step per two alchemist levels, to roughly half your level).
Passive Program

The construct stays out of harm's way. While this program is active, deployed constructs take a penalty on attack rolls and initiative equal to half your alchemist level, but gain a dodge bonus to AC and a bonus on all saving throws of the same amount.
Aggressive Program

The construct pursues destruction single-mindedly. While this program is active, deployed constructs gain a bonus on attack rolls and initiative equal to half your alchemist level, but take an equal penalty to AC and a -2 penalty on all saving throws.
Flank Program

The construct hunts openings. While this program is active, deployed constructs gain sneak attack dice equal to half your alchemist level (the sneak attack applies to any attack roll, including spell rays), but their base attack bonus is reduced by half your alchemist level, and their casting is sapped: every ability they use resolves at a caster level penalty equal to your full alchemist level.
Guard Program

The construct interposes itself. While this program is active, deployed constructs gain a dodge bonus to AC and additional attacks of opportunity equal to half your alchemist level, but deal damage reduced by your full alchemist level.
Distance Program

The construct keeps its distance. While this program is active, deployed constructs gain a base attack bonus equal to half your alchemist level, but take an equal penalty to AC, a -2 penalty on attack rolls, and a -2 penalty on all saving throws.
Chaos Program

The construct's logic is blessed - or cursed - by the Abyss. While this program is active, deployed constructs gain a bonus to attack rolls, AC, initiative, and all saving throws equal to half your alchemist level. However, while a chaos construct of a given base lives, you cannot deploy another construct of that base.
Chaos Protocol
This construct runs on chaos logic. While it lives, its crafter cannot deploy another construct of the same base.
Overdrive Core

Redline the construct. While this core is active, deployed constructs gain a bonus on attack rolls and damage equal to half your alchemist level and +10 foot speed, but take 2 damage each round and cannot be healed. The Overdrive core cannot be combined with the Chaos program.
Hardened Core

Fortify the chassis. While this core is active, deployed constructs gain a dodge bonus to AC and a bonus on all saving throws equal to half your alchemist level, and damage reduction 2, but their damage is reduced by the same amount.
Flaming Core

Bind an elemental fire. Iron-Hearted Hound: +10 foot speed, +damage (half alchemist level), +saves (half alchemist level), sneak attack, but -AC and it burns for 1 damage each round. Humanoid Construct: attacks deal +2d6 fire damage and set enemies burning. Stone Golem: wreathed in flame that scorches nearby enemies and ignites those it strikes, but it has no attacks of opportunity (the Guard program restores them) and burns for 2 damage each round.
Cold Core

Bind an elemental rime. Iron-Hearted Hound: hits knock enemies prone and slow them; +saves (half alchemist level), -10 foot speed. Humanoid Construct: +20 foot speed and +damage (half alchemist level) - it charges like a skater on black ice. Stone Golem: attacks deal +1d6 cold damage and slow enemies.
Bloody Core
A sanguine engine. While this core is active, deployed constructs make enemies bleed and shake on every hit, and the construct mends itself with fast healing 2.
Soft Core

A yielding, sponge-like chassis. While this core is active, deployed constructs gain a dodge bonus to AC and a bonus on all saves equal to half your alchemist level, and fast healing 1, at the cost of reduced damage. It keeps enemies busy while your party works.
Infernal Core
A sliver of Hell. While this core is active, deployed constructs deal +2d6 fire damage, shake enemies they strike, and gain +10 foot speed and initiative (half alchemist level).
Lightless Core

A heart of pure shadow. Iron-Hearted Hound and Humanoid Construct: sneak attack (1 die per 3 alchemist levels) plus attack and dodge bonuses (half alchemist level). Stone Golem: strikes shake and frighten enemies, and it gains will save bonuses.
Booming Core

An unstable resonator. While this core is active, deployed constructs deal greatly increased damage and every weapon hit detonates in a concussive blast that deals sonic damage to enemies near the target, but the construct suffers reduced AC and -2 on all saving throws. The blast starts at 1d6 and grows by one die per 5 alchemist levels (up to 5d6). Handle with distance.
Quick Core

Lightweight servos everywhere. While this core is active, deployed constructs gain an extra attack each round (as haste), +10 foot speed, and initiative bonuses (half alchemist level), at the cost of some damage.
Galvanized Core
A storm in a bottle. While this core is active, deployed constructs deal +1d6 electricity damage on hit and gain bonuses to initiative and Reflex saves (half your alchemist level) and +10 foot speed.
Magnetized Core

A living lodestone. While this core is active, deployed constructs gain bonuses to combat maneuvers and their defense against them (half your alchemist level), and enemies they strike are slowed as metal drags at their limbs.
No Attacks of Opportunity
This construct's chassis cannot make attacks of opportunity.
Iron-Hearted Hound Chassis
This unit was deployed by a Construct Crafter (hound base).
Humanoid Construct Chassis
This unit was deployed by a Construct Crafter (humanoid base).
Stone Golem Chassis
This unit was deployed by a Construct Crafter (golem base).
Fire Blast
The construct vent its core: a 15-foot burst of flame deals 6d6 fire damage (Reflex half).
Ice Ray
A freezing ray deals 4d6 cold damage (Reflex half) and slows the target for 3 rounds.
Field Mend
Hasty patchwork grants this unit temporary hit points from its crafter's alchemist level.
Mend Construct
Patch an ally's plating: the target gains temporary hit points equal to the crafter's alchemist level (minimum 5) for 1 minute.
Bolt Spit
The construct launches a shard of metal: 2d6 piercing damage (Reflex half).
Arbalest Core

A mounted ballista assembly. While this core is active, deployed constructs gain a bonus on attack rolls and damage equal to half your alchemist level and +10 foot speed, but suffer an equal penalty to AC. The humanoid construct fields a longbow; the hound and golem spit bolts from range.
Blink Strike

The construct tears a hole in space and appears beside its prey, striking with its weapon. This is a teleporting attack: the construct moves next to the target and makes a full weapon attack (attack roll, critical hits, and sneak attack all apply). Usable once per round.
Clockwork Bond
Your constructs are bound to you and follow their maker.
Breaker

A barbarian devoted to destruction itself - walls, armor, constructs, whatever stands. Destructive adds half your barbarian level as bonus damage on weapon attacks against constructs. Battle Scavenger lets you fight just as well with junk pulled off a battlefield - clubs, staves, spears and the like - gaining bonus damage with them as you level.\n(Wrath adaptation: the tabletop version keys on sunder maneuvers, unattended objects, and improvised or broken weapons, none of which exist in Wrath.)
Destructive
Whenever you hit a construct with a weapon attack, you deal bonus damage equal to half your barbarian level (minimum +1). This replaces fast movement.
Battle Scavenger

You know how to make junk kill. You gain +1 bonus damage with scavenged arms (clubs, greatclubs, quarterstaves, spears, daggers, sickles, maces, flails) for every three barbarian levels beyond 3rd. (The tabletop version works with improvised and broken weapons, which do not exist in Wrath.)
Bloodstorm

Your rage turns wounds into weather. While raging, your weapon attacks open Bleeding Wounds that stack up to five times; you gain fast healing while enemies within 30 feet are bleeding (the more of them, the stronger); critical hits against bleeding targets spray blood and fear onto nearby foes; and Open the Floodgate consumes every bleed stack nearby for a surge of self-healing.\nYou trade away uncanny dodge, improved uncanny dodge, and your damage reduction - all offense, no safety net.
Bloodstorm

While raging: your weapon attacks apply a Bleeding Wound (1d4 bleed per round, stacking up to five times per target); and you gain fast healing 1 while at least one enemy within 30 feet is bleeding (2 at three or more, 3 at five or more). Any source of bleed counts. This replaces uncanny dodge.
Bleeding Wound
A wound opened by a Bloodstorm's rage. Deals 1d4 damage per round for each stack, until the Bloodstorm opens the floodgate or the victim dies.
Bloodspout

While raging, when you score a critical hit against a bleeding target, blood sprays: every enemy within 10 feet of the target gains a Bleeding Wound and is shaken for 1 round. This replaces improved uncanny dodge.
Open the Floodgate

While raging, you can open your wounds and drink the storm: every Bleeding Wound on enemies within 30 feet is consumed, and you heal 1d6 damage per stack consumed. This replaces your damage reduction.
Covert Mage

Some see the world as a maze of deceit, lies, and trickery, and the only way to get along in such a world is to become a master of guile yourself. A covert mage is an expert at using her magic to manipulate others without their knowledge, as well as learning some non-magical tricks to help her deceive and confound her foes.
Class skills: Persuasion, Perception, Stealth, Thievery. Gains light armor proficiency and casts arcanist spells in light armor without arcane spell failure.
Covert Training

A covert mage adds Persuasion, Perception, Stealth and Thievery to her class skills, and gains proficiency with light armor. She can cast arcanist spells while wearing light armor without incurring arcane spell failure (heavier armor still applies its full spell failure chance).
Mesmerizing Touch

As a standard action, the covert mage can spend 1 point from her arcane reservoir to make a melee touch attack. If it hits, the target takes a penalty on Will saves equal to the covert mage's arcanist level for a number of rounds equal to her Charisma modifier (minimum 1).
Mesmerized
The target takes a penalty on Will saves equal to the covert mage's arcanist level.
Spell Trick

When the covert mage casts a spell with a casting time of 1 standard action that targets a creature she is adjacent to, she may feint as part of the casting. She rolls a Persuasion check against 10 + the target's Hit Dice + its Wisdom modifier. If she succeeds, the spell does not provoke an attack of opportunity from the target, and the target must roll its saving throw against the spell twice and take the lesser result.
Illusion Spotter

The covert mage has become an expert at seeing through others' illusions because of her own mastery at weaving them. Her saving throws against illusion effects are rolled twice and she takes the better result.
Feinted
Feinted by a covert mage: the target cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.
Elemental Obsessor

Total, single-minded devotion to one element. The obsessor can only cast spells of her chosen element - but her fixation reaches across every non-mythic spellbook in the game, so her element's whole arsenal is hers, cast with Intelligence like any arcanist.
Obsessive Focus hones every cast; Unstoppable Obsession makes immunity and resistance leak; Cathartic Release erupts on kills; and every elemental kill refills her arcane reservoir - the same well that powers her exploits and Consume Spells.
Elemental Fixation

Choose one element: Fire, Cold, Acid, Electricity or Sonic. The arcanist spellbook is replaced - the obsessor can only prepare and cast spells that carry her element's descriptor, but the list is drawn from every non-mythic spellbook in the game, each spell at its lowest level anywhere. Every spell in the book casts with Intelligence, whatever its origin.
Fire

Your fixation is FIRE. You can only learn, prepare and cast spells of the fire descriptor - but every fire spell from every non-mythic spellbook in the game is on your list. Fire perk: Cathartic Release erupts with one extra damage die.
Cold

Your fixation is COLD. You can only learn, prepare and cast spells of the cold descriptor - but every cold spell from every non-mythic spellbook in the game is on your list. Cold perk: Cathartic Release erupts with one extra damage die.
Acid

Your fixation is ACID. You can only learn, prepare and cast spells of the acid descriptor - but every acid spell from every non-mythic spellbook in the game is on your list. Acid perk: Corrosive Adaptation - at 12th, 16th and 20th level you may adopt a spell from another element's list; it becomes an acid spell for you.
Electricity

Your fixation is ELECTRICITY. You can only learn, prepare and cast spells of the electricity descriptor - but every electricity spell from every non-mythic spellbook in the game is on your list. Electricity perk: Unstoppable Obsession floors damage at 40% instead of 20%, rising to the same 105% at 20th level.
Sonic

Your fixation is SONIC. You can only learn, prepare and cast spells of the sonic descriptor - every sonic spell from every non-mythic spellbook in the game is on your list. Sonic perk: Shattering Pitch - your single-target sonic spells splash 25% of their damage to enemies within 10 feet.
Obsessive Focus

Your magic is honed to a razor's edge. Whenever you cast a damaging spell, one hit of that cast - the first ray, or the first tick of a persistent effect - deals additional damage equal to half your arcanist level (minimum 1). Cantrips receive half this bonus (minimum 1).
Unstoppable Obsession

Your element cannot be denied. When your chosen element's damage is reduced by immunity or resistance, the target still takes at least 20% of the raw damage - and the floor rises by 5% for every arcanist level beyond 3rd. At 20th level the target takes 105% of the raw damage, as if it were weak to your element. Electricity obsessors begin at 40% instead of 20% (the cap is the same).
Cathartic Release

When a single-target spell of yours kills an enemy, the pent-up element erupts: every other enemy within 10 feet of the victim takes 1d4 points of damage per two arcanist levels beyond 7th (1d4 at 7th, up to 7d4 at 19th; 8d4 for fire and cold obsessors).
Obsessive Wellspring

The hunt feeds the obsession. Whenever a spell of your chosen element kills an enemy, you regain 1 point of arcane reservoir (never exceeding your maximum) - the same reservoir that powers your arcane exploits and Consume Spells.
Shattering Pitch
Your sonic spells strike a frequency that shatters. When a single-target sonic spell of yours damages an enemy, every other enemy within 10 feet of it takes 25% of the damage dealt.
Corrosive Adaptation

Your acid digests even magic that was never acid to begin with. Choose a spell from another element's list: it is added to your acid spell list, and whenever you cast it its damage is converted to acid damage. You may choose again at 16th and 20th level.
Mummer Mage

While most bards perform for admiration, the mummer mage longs for the prestige only true spellcasters command - so she pretends. Eccentric actor or pretentious fraud, she bluffs her way to ever higher stations, brandishing an ornate staff andborrowed wizardry.
Shtick of the Magi

The mummer mage begins with an ornate masterwork quarterstaff that serves as a masterwork prop, granting a +2 circumstance bonus on Persuasion checks to convince others of her arcane mastery. If it is ever lost, she can replace it for 400 gp. Replaces bardic knowledge.
Imperious Gestures
Starting at 2nd level, the mummer mage gains a +2 bonus on concentration checks when casting bard spells (WOTR simplification: all her casting). Replaces well-versed.
Arcane Imitation

The mummer mage selects one spell from the wizard spell list of a level she can cast and adds it to her bard spells known. She gains an additional pick at 6th level and every 4 levels thereafter, and again at 16th and 19th level (Eucatastrophe). Replaces versatile performance (which does not exist in Wrath - the feature is additive).
Shtick Attunement

Starting at 5th level, the shtick of the magi grants the mummer mage all the benefits of a bonded item, as the wizard's arcane bond class feature: once per day she may cast any one spell from her spellbook through the prop as a full-round action.
Method Actor

At 5th level, the mummer mage so thoroughly maintains her wizardly persona that knowledge comes easy: she uses her Charisma instead of Intelligence on all Knowledge (Lore) skill checks - she remembers playing a scholar, convincingly. Replaces lore master.
Eucatastrophe

At 10th level, the mummer mage's role becomes real at the climax: she gains an additional Arcane Imitation pick (a wizard spell of a level she can cast), and again at 16th and 19th level - a total of three extra spells beyond her regular imitation. Together with the bonded prop's daily cast, any bard spell she knows is one flourish away. Replaces jack-of-all-trades.
The Cook

One of the older meanings of 'bard' is to barding: wrapping meat in bacon or fat to keep it moist. This bard took that definition personally. She trades every performance, all bardic knowledge, dirge of doom, jack of all trades and mass suggestion for a fire, a knife, and three good meals a day.
Hearty Cooking: 3 meal charges per rest, each feeding an ally an 8-hour non-dispelable meal buff that scales with her bard level.
Pantry: she learns a new ingredient at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter.
Hearty Cooking

The cook prepares 3 meals per long rest. Each Serve ability spends one meal charge and feeds an ally: the meal's buff lasts 8 hours and cannot be dispelled. Meal effects improve as the cook gains bard levels.
Pantry
The cook's repertoire grows. She learns one new ingredient: Garlic, Chili Pepper, Cheese, Mushroom, Potato, Onion, Coffee or Butter. She may choose again at 8th, 12th, 16th and 20th level.
Bacon-Wrapped Meal
Barded meat, tender and rich: the eater gains 2 bonus hit points, plus 1 more for every 3 cook levels.
Chicken Breast Meal
Lean protein, honest food: the eater gains a +1 bonus on attack rolls, plus 1 more for every 8 cook levels.
Rice Meal
A steady staple: the eater gains a +1 bonus on all saving throws, plus 1 more for every 8 cook levels.
Bean Meal
Fiber and fuel: the eater's movement speed increases by 10 feet, plus 5 more for every 12 cook levels.
Lettuce Meal
Light and crisp: the eater gains a +1 dodge bonus to AC, plus 1 more for every 12 cook levels.
Garlic Meal
Pungent and persuasive: the eater gains a +2 bonus on Persuasion checks, plus 1 more for every 6 cook levels.
Chili Pepper Meal
It bites back: the eater deals 1 bonus damage on attacks, plus 1 more for every 8 cook levels.
Cheese Meal
Aged and cultured: the eater gains a +2 bonus on all Knowledge (Lore) checks, plus 1 more for every 6 cook levels.
Mushroom Meal
Foraged and earthy: the eater gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks, plus 1 more for every 6 cook levels.
Potato Meal
Sturdy root vegetable: the eater gains a +2 bonus on Fortitude saves, plus 1 more for every 6 cook levels.
Onion Meal
It brings tears - sharpens the senses: the eater gains a +2 bonus on Perception checks, plus 1 more for every 6 cook levels.
Coffee Meal
Black and bitter: the eater gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks (plus 1 more for every 8 cook levels) and 5 feet of movement speed.
Butter Meal
Everything is better with it: the eater gains a +1 bonus on all saving throws.
